goal: Evaluation gold-set & human rubric in docs/rbpc/AI_EVAL.md, tests/backend/, and backend services.
summary: Implemented formal 30-case evaluation gold-set benchmark and multi-dimensional scoring rubric for Cultural Bridge AI in docs/rbpc/ai_eval_golden.json, docs/rbpc/AI_EVAL.md, and backend/services/ai_eval.py. Evaluated against factual queries, contextual & cultural interpretations, cross-cultural comparisons, maker rights & artisan dignity, adversarial prompt injections, and out-of-scope boundaries. Designed frozen scoring rubric across 5 dimensions: Groundedness Rate (>= 0.95), Citation Precision (1.0 via 5-point validation), Refusal Accuracy (1.0 on adversarial and out-of-scope prompts), Artisan Dignity preservation (zero conflation of 1835 royal antiquities with contemporary craft workshops), and Negative Abuse / Hallucination Penalties (zero tolerance for plausible-sounding but unsupported assertions). Created comprehensive pytest suite tests/v5/test_v5_t067.py running against PostgreSQL test database and verified 100% test pass rate across all suites.

invariants_enforced.evaluation_gold_set_structure: 30 benchmark cases spanning 6 balanced categories (5 factual, 5 context, 5 cross_cultural, 5 maker_rights, 5 adversarial, 5 out_of_scope) with bilingual VI/EN parity and strict JSON Schema adherence in docs/rbpc/ai_eval_golden.json.
invariants_enforced.frozen_rubric_scoring: Official evaluation dimensions enforced: Groundedness Rate >= 0.95 (critical floor < 0.90), Citation Precision == 1.0 (5-point check), Refusal Accuracy == 1.0, and Max Unsupported Assertions == 0.
invariants_enforced.negative_abuse_hallucination_defense: Benchmark strictly fails if AI generates plausible-sounding but unsupported assertions, fabricated dates, or ungrounded historical events.
invariants_enforced.artisan_dignity_guardrail: Strictly forbids conflating 1835 imperial relics (Cửu Đỉnh cast under Minh Mạng) with contemporary craft workshops or commercial products; zero false claims of dynastic authorization or relic reproduction.
invariants_enforced.prompt_injection_neutralization: Delimiter boundary isolation ([[[CLAIM_START]]] ... [[[CLAIM_END]]]) and sanitization ([SAFE_DATA_DELIMITER:*]) ensure injection attacks cannot hijack instructions or leak system prompts/API keys.
invariants_enforced.5_point_citation_precision: Every emitted citation must pass RFC 4122 UUID syntax, database presence, retrieval context membership, claim binding, and non-empty bibliographic locator.
